title: Article 14 — Equality before law
summary: Article 14 says the State must not deny any person equality before the law or equal protection of the laws within the territory of India. It is part of Part III, Fundamental Rights.

source.title: The Constitution of India — Legislative Department, Government of India

title: Article 19 — Certain freedoms
summary: Article 19(1) lists freedoms for citizens, including speech and expression, peaceful assembly without arms, forming associations, movement and residence within India, and practising a profession or trade. The Constitution also sets out reasonable restrictions, including in clause (2) for speech and expression.

source.title: The Constitution of India — Legislative Department, Government of India

title: Article 21 — Life and personal liberty
summary: Article 21 protects life and personal liberty. Its text says no person may be deprived of life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law. It is part of Part III, Fundamental Rights.

source.title: The Constitution of India — Legislative Department, Government of India
